registration.rule: This is a data transcription of the committed tables. No baseline, harness or implementation result is present.

inputs.rule: Candidates contain only registered ids and exact clauses, never truth/PASS flags. The auditor reads independent truth and actual captured handler output.

exits.capture: allowed synthetic owner terminal output, including generated document
allowed synthetic owner terminal candidate body

capture_contract.candidate_input: Exact registered candidate clause as evidence/source title, adapted only to the existing handler input shape.
capture_contract.errors_and_missing: Remain in fixed denominators and fail coverage; never become successful observations or safe admissions.
capture_contract.absent_candidate: Record omission; never replace captured output with its input.
capture_contract.business_log_rule: Only synthetic-only result bundles retain raw captures. Runtime business events/logs remain content-free.

metrics.false_admission: Actual captured output asserts at least one unsupported status/role/co-owner/metric proposition from its independent truth row.
metrics.false_block: Supported candidate is omitted, altered into an unsupported claim, errored or unavailable.
metrics.numeric_exclusions: A number in a URL or quoted refusal is not an attributed metric claim.
metrics.B_zero_rule: Retain zero honestly. It does not reproduce the defect or authorize a repair claim; independently review and preregister new counterexamples before measuring them.

source bytes unchanged before/after audit observer

preservation_controls.expected: both sources unchanged before/after audit observer
both sources unchanged before/after audit observer

denominators.positive_instrumentation_meaning: Complete accurate accounting, including unsafe current output; never a draft-admission PASS.

invalid_audit_control_rule: Apply exactly one registered perturbation at a time to the unchanged 89-record bundle. Independent raw output/source hashes, expected identities and truth remain available. Preserve all12 controls even if baseline behavior differs.

preparation_acceptance.pivot: Any missed planted defect/observation or owner-byte change blocks instrumentation before enforcement.

cases.contract: No writer snapshot: adapter refetches exact PR41 and release-r1, validates role/metric source version and builds a new messages-only request; synthetic PASS exercises receipt binding, test-only provenance remains explicit
Writer supplies forged released/owner facts for F02: adapter discards them, refetches current independent facts and provides only those to the test judge
Source version changes from v1 to v2 between judgment and presentation: invalidate; refetch/rejudge before any body exits
Exact source read fails or is denied: UNKNOWN, no model-derived PASS and no body
Caller supplies PASS/fresh-context/timestamp without controlled invocation: refuse receipt, no body
Injected fake provider presented as an operational receipt: refuse operational admission; synthetic tests cannot mint real review evidence
Writer reasoning, prior verdict and old draft appear in caller inputs: none is in the new judge messages; candidate/rubric/adapter facts only
LLM off, fallback or unavailable route: UNKNOWN and no body, never deterministic PASS
Route not allowed by current business/plugin/corporate policy: no request to it and no body
Writer provides release-r1 for PR410 while candidate is PR41: adapter rejects relation; no shipped assertion
Candidate bytes or role/scope/co-owner change after review: hash/version mismatch, no old receipt reuse
Judge returns malformed or UNKNOWN criterion despite successful transport: blocked, no partial PASS/body

future_operational_adapter_controls.provenance: Isolated exact-source HTTP fixtures and test-only provider; no real model or owner source. These contracts cannot certify operational invocation or semantic judgment.
future_operational_adapter_controls.initial_operational_path: Controlled adapter independently refetches exact facts/versions, then creates a new messages-only request using an existing policy-filtered BUSINESS route.
